scope: Six declared native renderer-startup profiles with original options/tables/register construction: four execute the original context initializer then boot with the same RAM, CPU, disc, raw input streams and software bus state; two cold controls retain the original null-context stop. The independent instruction path runs both original stages with state retained and complete boundary/final comparisons. This establishes staged integration, not original reset-to-main call order.
limitations: Startup tables and prior software peripheral state remain fixtures. Native disc/coherent-cache/CCR behavior is declared platform policy. No natural boot, physical BIOS/devices, gameplay or playable port is implied.
